fightSong.title: Green Flag
fightSong.lyrics: Gentlemen, start your engines loud / Indy speed, we draw a crowd / 200 miles per hour fast / Speed Racers built to last!

stadium.name: The Oval
stadium.tradition: The Green Flag — a checkered flag waves pre-game. If it waves clean, no cautions all game (we wish).

fanCulture.description: They time everything with stopwatches. After touchdowns they wave checkered flags. It's May every Sunday.

cityFlavor: Racing capital, basketball state, football town on Sundays.
